1704-5195-7063-7694.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-5195-7063-7694.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Multiversal Incursion, Krark, any additional copies of Krark, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color..
Resolve a Krark trigger, flipping a coin and returning the Multiversal Incursion card to your hand if you lose and copying it if you win.
If you copy Multiversal Incursion, Storm-Kiln Artist triggers again, causing you to repeat steps 3 to 4.
Repeat steps 5—6 for each Krark trigger.
If Multiversal Incursion is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Multiversal Incursion card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Ember Island Production, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Multiversal Incursion and Ember Island Production end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

1479-3585-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3585-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Greensleeves trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3518-3668-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying {U}{U}, causing it to enter with vanishing 3 as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

339-677-2034-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha, adding {C}{C}
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2137-4068-4642.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2137-4068-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4068-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-4871--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-4871--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2438-3197-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-6006-6970-7297-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4377-5163-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Roon of the Hidden Realm.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-3381-6972.description:
Activate Morgue Toad by sacrificing it.
When Morgue Toad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

4694-5686-7652.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
4694-5686-7652.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-2511-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1409-3671-6751.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve both Wily Goblin triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2366-3512-5295-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-5295-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4955-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
4955-7070--141.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
4955-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

1339-2034-2122-7061.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-7061.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4659-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4659-6720.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3391-4871-6019-6797.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

141-3645-6798.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-6260-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Caradora.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-6260-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

1808-2981-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
1808-2981-6291.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1879-3204-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1879-3204-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

804-2533-4681-5147.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

240-413-526.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-413-526.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, and if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Life Finds A Way trigger, if applicable, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
When the Egg enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
240-413-526.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

147-167-4050.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

184-2713-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-2713-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {1}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1856-4550-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
1856-4550-5256.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Zombie's power.
Repeat.

360-2919-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
360-2919-3490-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the last Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1651-4259-4659.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

195-1912-3371.notablePrerequisites: Codie does not have summoning sickness.
195-1912-3371.description:
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting Codie.
Holding priority, activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve Chain Stasis, untapping Codie and causing you to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, with the copy targeting Codie.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may choose not to copy Chain Stasis and cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

238-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures.
238-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gerrard and any two other nontoken creatures, adding six {C}.
Nim Deathmantle and Gerrard trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger, returning all artifact and creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

813-2628-4377.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cycle the instant/sorcery each turn
813-2628-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant and/or sorcery card in hand with cycling.
813-2628-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate any instant/sorcery card in your hand's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons and the card with cycling from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat each turn.
